name: The Holy Trinity
overview: Scripture reveals the Holy Trinity as one God existing in three distinct persons: the Father, the Son, and the Holy Ghost. From the plural language in Genesis 1:26 indicating the divine 'us,' to Jesus’ declaration of oneness with the Father in John 10:30, and the clear command in Matthew 28:19 to baptize in the name of all three persons, the Bible affirms their unity and distinct roles. The Word, identified as God in John 1:1 and made flesh in John 1:14, along with the Holy Ghost sent by the Father as described in John 14:26, further underscores the coexistent and cooperative nature of the Trinity in the work of creation, redemption, and teaching.
